mood: A paper with two red words on it, a bench outside a half-open door, and a whole day of waiting.

hero.alt: A white city curves around a wide blue harbor, seen from high above, a beam of light rising from its tallest tower.

media.alt: The dark outline of a tall man in a fur-collared greatcoat with wide cuffs, one hand a fist, the other holding an open scroll.
